import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_6/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_6/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source2_6_0 and Source2_6_1 on 'calaccess_committee_id'
joined = pd.merge(df0[['calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name']], 
                  df1[['calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'amount']], 
                  on='calaccess_committee_id', 
                  suffixes=('_x', '_y'))

# Group by Source2_6_1.committee_name (which is committee_name_y after join)
# and sum the amounts
grouped = joined.groupby('committee_name_y', dropna=False, as_index=False)['amount'].sum()

# Rename columns to match target schema
grouped.rename(columns={'committee_name_y': 'committee_name_x'}, inplace=True)

# Ensure 'committee_name_x' is string and 'amount' is float
grouped['committee_name_x'] = grouped['committee_name_x'].astype(str)
grouped['amount'] = grouped['amount'].astype(float)

# Save to target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_6/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_6/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_6/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on calaccess_committee_id
joined = pd.merge(
    source0,
    source1,
    how="inner",
    left_on="calaccess_committee_id",
    right_on="calaccess_committee_id",
    suffixes=('_x', '')
)

# Rename committee_name_x to match target schema
joined = joined.rename(columns={"committee_name_x": "committee_name_x"})

# The target schema has 'committee_name_x' and 'amount'
# Use committee_name from source0 as committee_name_x (leftmost unique string column)
# The join will produce committee_name_x from source0 as 'committee_name' with suffix '_x' after merge
# Actually, after merge, source0.committee_name is 'committee_name_x' (due to suffixes)
# So rename source0.committee_name to committee_name_x before groupby

# The join result has 'committee_name_x' from source0 as 'committee_name_x' (due to suffixes)
# But pandas merge with suffixes=('_x', '') will rename source0.committee_name to 'committee_name_x'
# So no rename needed here

# Group by committee_name_x and sum amount
result = joined.groupby("committee_name_x", as_index=False).agg({"amount": "sum"})

# Write to target file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_6/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
